info.title: UniverAcademy Telegram browser link (review fragment)
info.description: Links the Telegram account confirmed by Log In With Telegram (OpenID Connect, authorization code with PKCE) to the Clerk-verified person. Additive; it changes no student operation. Off unless UA_TELEGRAM_LOGIN_ENABLED is true.

post.description: Requires a fresh Clerk bearer token and the one-time Telegram authorization code with its PKCE verifier. The server exchanges the code with the client secret, verifies Telegram's signed id_token and links exactly the confirmed Telegram account to the verified person. A code works once. An already linked identical pair is acknowledged without effect. A different existing link is a conflict. No session is issued.

401.description: CLERK_TOKEN_INVALID, CLERK_SESSION_REVOKED, INIT_DATA_INVALID (Telegram refused or did not sign the confirmation), INIT_DATA_EXPIRED.

503.description: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: Telegram, the key set or the database is unavailable; nothing was linked.
